Hi Sarah —

Great connecting today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the PoC: 

- Discovery highlights: Irteq wants to validate latency under mixed workloads, evaluate SSO/SAML flow for internal users, and confirm audit/logging surface for compliance.
- Success criteria we heard: <30ms median gen latency for standard queries, SSO + SCIM working for pilot group, access to token-level audit logs.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep dive (demo + infra/SSO + procurement checklist). Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team (all times PDT):
- Mon Apr 12: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Tue Apr 13: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

I’ve looped in Vivek (platform lead) to cover deployment options (Dedicated vs Private) and to answer any infra/network questions. If you can add your security/procurement contacts to the thread that would be helpful so we can ensure they see artifacts ahead of the call.

Typical agenda I propose (feel free to adjust):
1) 10–15m: short product demo focused on real workload patterns
2) 20–25m: SSO/SCIM, networking, data flow (VPC/on-prem options)
3) 10–15m: procurement checklist + next steps (SLA, license, timelines)

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks —

Hi Sarah / Rajiv / Lena —

Kimberly from Redwood security here. Nice to meet you all. Attaching a short SOC 2 snapshot and a lightweight SSO integration guide to help Rajiv validate the integration surface ahead of the call.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood-SOC2-2026-snapshot.pdf (summary of scope + controls)
- sso-integration-guide.pdf (SAML/SCIM steps and example metadata)

Answers to the immediate questions:
- Log retention: by default audit & token-level logs are retained for 90 days. For Dedicated and Private deployments we support configurable retention (customer-managed) and we can provide longer retention under contract.
- Data residency: Private deployments can be hosted in your VPC/region; hosted accounts are in US regions by default but we can discuss EU/APAC options if required.

If you want specific export formats or more detailed control evidence, we can prepare that for procurement — let me know the classification level and any export template you prefer.

Best,
Kimberly Park
